images.name: botellas
images.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup / compositing edit.
Asset type: one finished photographic category image for the Varcun website.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: black metal water bottle held in a person's right hand in an indoor gym.
Input image 2 is the exact Varcun logo reference, a turquoise outer V and white inner V on navy; use its geometry accurately.
Primary request: recreate image 1 with the same bottle, cap, hand, wristband, framing and photographic realism. Change the gym's painted wall/background colour design to Varcun: deep navy #061C32 and #092A49 with flowing aqua/turquoise #08BFC4 accents, no orange, pink or purple decoration. Keep a believable softly blurred gym, natural material textures and highlights.
Add a tasteful, clearly readable, physically printed Varcun logo centred on the bottle body. The mark should follow image 2 and be followed below by the exact word "VARCUN" in a small modern sans serif, white on the black bottle. The logo must look like real printing that follows the bottle curvature, not a floating overlay.
Keep the black colour, silhouette, steel bottle shape and cap of the target. Real hand anatomy and same pose. Subject fills the central 70 percent; leave 8 percent side margins for responsive cropping. Square 1024x1024 output, a single full bleed photograph.
Avoid any UI, rounded card frame, numbers, arrows, slogans, other logos, watermark, collage or extra products.
